name: kneeling wrist flexor stretch
description: Kneeling on the floor, you press your palms down to stretch the underside of the forearms. Useful for lifters with tight wrists.
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place your palms down with fingers pointing toward your knees.
Keep your palms flat and arms straight.
Slowly sit your hips back to increase the stretch.
Stop when you feel a pull along the inner forearms.
Ease off gently and shake out your hands.
